_about: Public-domain George Bull (1634-1710, Bishop of St David's, defender of the Nicene faith) for the Word Hoard: his Works edited by Edward Burton with Robert Nelson's Life (7 vols in 8, Oxford 1846; the Latin treatises are in Latin there), and the Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology English translations of the Defensio Fidei Nicaenae (2 vols, 1851), Harmonia Apostolica (1842), Examen Censurae (1844) and the Judicium Ecclesiae Catholicae (1855), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 13 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
